# Goals only count while a game is playing (spec 02 §3).
sensor home_goal
expect games 0
start official
sensor other_role             # not a goal role: ignored
expect score 0:0
wait 5s
sensor home_goal at=-10s      # stamped before kickoff (retried after a replug): ignored
expect score 0:0
sensor home_goal at=-2s       # late but after kickoff: counts
expect score 0:1
sensor home_goal at=+5s       # module clock ahead: stamped now
expect score 0:2
